specific_checks: All 16 selected original problem/cover/acknowledgement pages retained; original printed 38-page numbering preserved and translated, not renumbered.
Source logos, date, author names, diagrams, grey panels, mathematical font programs and physical math glyph sizes/baselines preserved.
Exact 17 original grey source-panel fill/stroke pairs are guarded independently from moving inline expression paths.
Pages3/4/9/10/11/14 reviewed for sentence-final native scientific tokens and Korean suffix order; every extra punctuation slot has an exact source guard.
Page5 native italic quaternion q and Korean suffix have a reviewed 0.6pt optical clearance; native-ink collision count is zero.
Page6 italic inline expressions retain native geometry; precise added-text matrices keep actual new Korean glyph origins within 0.001pt.
Fourteen raster-only language labels on pages7/9/10 translated over narrow reviewed prose masks; matching style/point-size inference is explicit because bitmap font metadata is unavailable.
All source images retain exact encoded bytes/filter data and original placements. Whole native inline expressions alone move horizontally within original prose rows.
No English-span-width reservation, font-size reduction, mathematical retypesetting, editorial notes or new formula rasterization.
